user.title: HA Sentinel
user.description: Sentinel observes availability of your entities locally. Data stays in this Home Assistant instance, no active network probes and no AI are enabled. Default retention: 7 days of observations.

data.modules_doctor: Doctor (health rules); core keeps running when off
data.modules_autopilot: Autopilot (lint, drafts, replay; never enables AI)

data.ingestion_numeric_sampling: Numeric sampling for selected entities and purposes

data_description.ingestion_allowed_domains: Empty = every domain except privacy exclusions (person, zone, trackers, media, cameras, text). Privacy exclusions always win.

data.notifications_enabled: Show new incidents as Home Assistant notifications

data.managed_write_enabled: Allow Sentinel to write managed files (restore)
data.managed_dir: Managed files directory (inside the config directory)

data.network_active_probes: Active network probes (level N1, approved targets only)

error.invalid_cidr: Allowed address ranges: enter one or more CIDR ranges separated by commas, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24.

unsupported_schema.title: HA Sentinel database is newer than this version
unsupported_schema.description: The file {file} was written by a newer Sentinel. This version opens it read-only and stores nothing. Reinstall the newer Sentinel, or follow the downgrade steps in the runbook (restore the pre-migration backup sentinel.vN.bak.db).

database_corrupted.title: HA Sentinel database is damaged
database_corrupted.description: The file {file} could not be read. It was left untouched for diagnosis and Sentinel runs without storing history. Restore it from a Home Assistant backup or delete Sentinel data in the panel to start over.

migration_failed.title: HA Sentinel database upgrade failed
migration_failed.description: Upgrading {file} failed and was rolled back; the file and its pre-migration backup are untouched. Sentinel runs without storing history. Report the issue and keep both files.

insufficient_space_for_migration.title: Not enough disk space to upgrade HA Sentinel data
insufficient_space_for_migration.description: Upgrading {file} needs free space of twice the database size (at least 256 MiB). Sentinel runs read-only until space is available.
